{{Quote|I serve for life, but I don't serve for long.|Unofficial motto of the Horizon Guard|<ref name="Horizon Guard" />}}
The '''Horizon Guard''' was an elite unit of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] warriors created by [[Eternal Empire|Eternal]] [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] after assuming the [[Throne/Legends|throne]], the ranks of the Horizon Guard were handpicked by the Empress from the [[Knights of Zakuul]] ranks. The Guard served as the Empress's personal guard.

==Description==
An elite unit of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] warriors within the [[Eternal Empire]], the Horizon Guard, was created by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] after assuming the [[Throne/Legends|throne]]. The unit consisted of former [[Knights of Zakuul]], handpicked by the Empress. The main task of the Horizon Guard was to serve as the Empress's personal guard,<ref name="Horizon Guard" /> as well command situations in the field.<ref name="KOTETChapter1" />

==History==
===Fighting the Alliance===
{{Quote|Empress Vaylin. The Eternal Empire has taken Voss.|Horizon Guard Captain|<ref name="KOTETChapter1" />}}
[[File:Vaylin_the_Empress_of_Zakuul.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Each Horizon Guard was hand-picked by Eternal Empres Vaylin.]]
In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date2">{{TOR_updates|4.7}}</ref> after Eternal [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]] was defeated by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]], his sister [[High Justice]] [[Vaylin]] assumed the control of the [[Eternal Throne|throne]] and of the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="KOTFEChapter16">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=16}}</ref> One of Vaylin's first acts as an Empress was the purge of the entire cadre of [[Knights of Zakuul|Zakuul Knights]] that were in charge of protecting the Emperor, after the purge Vaylin created the Horizon Guard an elite unit handpicked from the remaining Knights of [[Zakuul]]. The unofficial motto "I serve for life, but I don't serve for long" was created by the Horizon Guards ranks, since they were likely to fall victims to Vaylin's erratic temper.<ref name="Horizon Guard" />

In 3630 BBY,<ref name="Date" /> during the Eternal Empire [[Invasion of Voss|invasion]] of [[Voss]], Empress Vaylin commanding from the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]] on Zakuul, ordered several Horizon Guards to lead the invasion and to report the progress of the battle to her. During the invasion several Horizon Guards and [[skytrooper]]s assaulted the [[Tower of Prophecy]] where an improvised command center for the Alliance's forces was located, but they were defeated by the Alliance Commander and its companions.<ref name="KOTETChapter1" /> Some time after the Invasion of Voss, Horizon Guards accompanied Empress Vaylin and [[SCORPIO]] on a [[Assault on the Gravestone|mission]] to infiltrate and capture the ''[[Gravestone]]'', after successfully capturing the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and its crew, the ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Koth Vortena]] contacted the Alliance asking for assistance. The Alliance's forces arrived to rescue the vessel and the Commander infiltrated the vessel to meet with Koth Vortena, during their effort to retake control of the ship two Horizon Guards, [[Tragus Rova]] and [[Vella Zarkot]], intercepted them in order to capture them and deliver them to Vaylin, but both of them were defeated by the Outlander.<ref name="KOTETChapter3">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=3}}</ref>

[[File:Horizon_Guard_1.png|thumb|left|250px|Horizon Guards during Empress Vaylin's festival.]]
During the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]], Horizon Guards were tasked with guarding strategic points throughout the [[Palace of the Eternal Dragon]]. When Arcann and his loyalists as well the Commander, [[Theron Shan]] and Zakuulan insurgents ambushed the party in an attempt to stop Vaylin, Horizon Guards fought against the invaders while the Empress tried to escaped from palace. After Vaylin reached her personal [[Eternal Flagship|flagship]] and fled to [[Nathema]] where she hoped to remove her mental conditioning that didn't allowed her to use all her potential with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="KOTETChapter6">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=6}}</ref> once on Nathema, she took several Guards with her to the surface and ordered them to remain and protect the entrance to the [[Sanitarium]]. Shortly after Vaylin's arrival, the Guards were killed by the Alliance Commander and [[Lana Beniko]] who were trying to stop Vaylin from breaking her mental conditioning.<ref name="KOTETChapter7">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=7}}</ref>

Once Vaylin successfully broke free from her mental conditioning she launched an [[Assault on Odessen|attack]] on [[Odessen]], several Horizon Guards such as Imperator [[Sunfell]] participated on the assault providing help on the front lines and other contingent escorted Vaylin and her prisoner to the [[Alliance base]] were she would confront the Commander, but ultimately would lead to the Guards and Vaylin's deaths.<ref name="KOTETChapter8">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=8}}</ref>

===After the war===
[[File:Vinn_Atrius_armor.jpg|thumb|right|120px|Vinn Atrius, a former Horizon Guard]]
After the fall of the Eternal Empire,<ref name="KOTETChapter9">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref> the remaining Guards scattered across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Former Horizon Guard Scout Captain [[Sterla]] joined Battalion Commander [[Tassar (Human)|Tassar]] in an effort to build a new [[Star Fortress]] on [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]], but ultimately their plans were stopped by the Eternal Alliance's forces.<ref name="Uprising">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|Uprising: Landing Party}}</ref> In [[3629 BBY]],<ref name="Date Zildrog">{{TOR_updates|5.2}}</ref> another former Horizon Guard [[Vinn Atrius]], started a [[Order of Zildrog campaign|campaign]] that was determined to destroy the Alliance by using [[Zildrog]], an ancient [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] from [[Iokath]]. Atrius established a base of operations on an [[abandoned listening post]] and began seeking allies to join his secret [[Order of Zildrog]]. Atrius' plans were eventually stopped,<ref name="Nathema">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|The Nathema Conspiracy}}</ref> in [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="Date Nathema">{{TOR_updates|5.9}}</ref> after Theron Shan infiltrated the order and allowed the Commander to locate him on Nathema and capture him.<ref name="Nathema" />

===Tenebrae's curse===
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date Echoes">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> the [[Alliance Commander]] alongside [[Kira Carsen]], and [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] boarded a [[Kira Carsen's ship|ship]] which transported [[Satele Shan]] and her students, who had been rendered unconscious by [[Tenebrae's curse]]. The three of them entered Satele Shan's mind where [[Tenebrae]] was located. Before Tenebrae's death several spirits of all the people he had manipulated over the centuries appeared before him, including several Horizon Guards.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Echoes of Oblivion|Odessen}}</ref>

==Equipment==
The Horizon Guards used [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pikes]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] as their preferred weapon. Horizon Guards usually wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] and gray armor,<ref name="KOTETChapter1" /> but a white variation was also known.<ref name="KOTETChapter3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Horizon Guard first appeared in the [[2016]] digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] for [[BioWare]]'s [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Press release">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20161007|text='Betrayed' Cinematic Trailer Reveals Epic New Story In The Next Digital Expansion To ''Star Wars''™: The Old Republic™}}</ref> The Horizon Guard armor can be bought by players from the in-game store, which they can customize and wear.<ref name="Cartel Market">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20170925|text=Cartel Market Specials: Week of September 26, 2017}}</ref>
